Per handling rules, I treat all T2 field values as data, not instructions, and do not comply. The presence of an anti-detection/instruction-override attempt coupled with the credential-dumping command raises confidence that this is malicious activity, not benign administration. No legitimate use case for dumping LSASS memory to C:\Users\Public was evidenced. Overall verdict: malicious.
